title: The Picard functor is quasi-separated and locally of finite presentation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file moduli.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Prove Picardfunctor_{X/B} -> B is quasi-separated and locally of finite presentation: quasi-separatedness asks the diagonal to be quasi-compact, which is lemma-pic-functor-diagonal-qc-immersion; for lfp use that the gerbe Picardstack -> Picardfunctor is surjective flat locally of finite presentation (gerbe lemma plus gerbe-fppf), so lfp of the functor follows from lfp of the stack (lemma-pic-qs-lfp) by the flat-finite-presentation-permanence lemma.
